about: Version 1 of Fifteen Days: the files it was made from, all committed. The live editor (scripts/editor-data.mjs, /@<name>/1/shot/<shot>) reads only these, so it works the same on any fork.
title: Fifteen Days

delivery.about: The same cut, packaged to start sooner (owner, 2026-10-18; src/lib/scene-delivery.ts). The cut above stays the version's file; these are copies made from it with ffmpeg 9.0.1 and uploaded by npm run publish:scene-video.

wide.same_as_cut: video and audio streams bit-identical (ffmpeg -f streamhash: video 0ecb2be4…, audio 829cca4c…)

phone.made: ffmpeg -i coverage-v6.mp4 -map 0 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -profile:v high -preset slow -crf 24 -maxrate 900k -bufsize 1800k -g 60 -keyint_min 30 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a copy, then re-wrapped as wide.mp4
